Description: Trunk Blast: water spray that knocks back, staggers and puts out fires. Trunk Throw: picks up a nearby chunk and hurls it.
Chews on a wooden building, damaging it and refilling its own food. Hungry wild animals do this to your buildings on their own.
Runs at a target and dies, setting off its normal death effect (explosion, or tox cloud for the toxalope).
Sprays burning fuel in a small radius around itself. Requires Biotech.
Turns invisible (the same invisibility as Royalty's psycast) until it attacks. Movie reference: Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon.
Dashes along the ground at a target, battering and knocking back enemies where it lands. Bigger animals hit harder.
Fast dash along the ground to a nearby spot.
Rapidly heals its injuries for a short time; cast automatically when badly hurt. Marvel reference.
Melee bite that builds up toxins, scaled by the target's toxic resistance and the size of the animal. Uses the game's ToxicBite damage.
Targets another animal of its kind, puts both of their abilities on cooldown, and creates another one.
Effect not decided yet: make enemies flee, a debuff, or a stink gas cloud.
Undecided. Nine Lives: a killing blow occasionally downs the cat instead. Pounce: a leap attack.
Undecided, may stay untagged. Grabs a target, stunning it and dealing heavy damage.
Hides in its shell for 20 seconds: big armor boost, but it barely moves. Cast automatically when hurt.
Jumps to a nearby spot.
Heavy melee hit with knockback. Bigger animals kick harder.
Short-range spit that halves sight for 15 seconds.
Launches a volley of quills at a target.
Allies who hear it get +25% melee damage and +20% move speed for 30 seconds. Cast automatically when enemies get close.
A threat with up to a 40% chance to send each nearby enemy fleeing in terror. Plays the animal's own call, so geese honk.
Digs in and pops up elsewhere.
Grabs a nearby item and runs off with it.
Distracts an enemy with mimicry.
A diving attack from above.
Brings back a downed colonist or an item.
Calls nearby insects to the caster.
